annotation.title_clean: H.R. 1186: Curbing Realistic Exploitative Electronic Pedophilic Robots Act 2.0 (CREEPER Act 2.0)
annotation.title_en: H.R. 1186: Curbing Realistic Exploitative Electronic Pedophilic Robots Act 2.0 (CREEPER Act 2.0)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. House of Representatives (Rep. Buchanan and Rep. Moskowitz)
annotation.summary_en: US House bill introduced February 2025 amending Title 18 to prohibit importing or transporting child sex dolls, including robots resembling minors, and creating a federal trafficking offense with penalties of up to five years for a first offense and ten years for repeat offenses.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines 'child sex doll' to include anatomically correct dolls, mannequins or robots resembling minors intended for sexual acts
Amends 18 U.S.C. 1462 to bar importation or transportation of child sex dolls
Creates new 18 U.S.C. 1471 criminalizing buying, selling, distributing or possessing them in interstate or foreign commerce
Penalties: up to 5 years first offense, up to 10 years for subsequent offenses
Findings link dolls and robots to child exploitation and normalization of abuse
